head_commit.message:
Fix stretched Championship card and header label in Full Bracket view

The champion card used class "champ", which collided with an unrelated
.champ style from the Standings screen (absolute-positioned with
left/right/bottom, stretching the card). Renamed to fb-champ. Also
swap the header's round label for "Full Bracket" while that view is
active, restoring the real round name on switching back.

Fix bottom nav getting hidden behind mobile Chrome's toolbar

Switch .app height from 100vh to 100dvh (dynamic viewport height),
which accounts for mobile browser chrome showing/hiding instead of
being sized against the full screen height regardless of toolbar state.

Add keep-alive GitHub Action and commissioner season export

Daily workflow pings Supabase so the free-tier project never idles out.
Export button on each season card downloads films/players/brackets/picks
as JSON for disaster recovery, since free-tier Supabase has no backups.
